children: plans to open 14 new stores in the next two months in a mini burst of development that includes replacing some smaller stores with larger ones. The November openings include four Canadian warehouses in Alberta and Ontario.

The membership-based retailer plans warehouses in Lee's Summit, Missouri; The Colony, Texas; Amherst, New York; Lawrence, Kansas; Camarillo and Vallejo, California; South Meridian, Idaho; Chandler, Arizona; Newport News, Virginia; Franklin, Wisconsin; and Northeast Edmonton, Lloydminster, East Windsor, and Wasaga Beach in Canada.

Earlier this year, CEO Ron Vachris said the company aims to open 30 or more warehouses annually over the next five to ten years. The store growth could include locations in Mexico, Canada, Asia, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand as sites for future warehouses.
